targets.name: Alaska
targets.explanation: USAs største delstat, nordvest i Nord-Amerika. Sikt mot midten av fastlandsområdet.
targets.enExplanation: The largest US state, in northwestern North America. Aim for the centre of the mainland area.
targets.source: Representative point in mainland Alaska; USGS geographic context.

targets.name: Florida
targets.explanation: Delstat og halvøy sørøst i USA, mellom Mexicogolfen og Atlanterhavet.
targets.enExplanation: A state and peninsula in the southeastern USA, between the Gulf of Mexico and the Atlantic Ocean.
targets.source: Representative point in the Florida peninsula; USGS geographic context.

targets.name: Bali
targets.explanation: Indonesisk øy mellom Java og Lombok, kjent som reisemål.
targets.enExplanation: An Indonesian island between Java and Lombok, well known as a travel destination.

targets.name: Hiroshima
targets.explanation: Japansk by på Honshu, rammet av en atombombe i 1945.
targets.enExplanation: A Japanese city on Honshu, struck by an atomic bomb in 1945.

targets.name: Tsjernobyl
targets.explanation: By nord i Ukraina, kjent for atomkraftulykken i 1986 ved kraftverket i nærheten.
targets.enExplanation: A city in northern Ukraine, known for the 1986 nuclear disaster at the nearby power plant.
targets.source: Chernobyl town centre, Ukraine; not the power station.

targets.name: Auschwitz
targets.explanation: Tidligere nazistisk konsentrasjons- og utryddelsesleir ved Oświęcim i Polen.
targets.enExplanation: A former Nazi concentration and extermination camp near Oświęcim in Poland.
targets.source: Auschwitz I memorial site, Oświęcim, Poland.
